meta.name: tfx-prune
meta.description: 명시 `tfx-prune` 또는 TFX 3자 합의 cleanup을 요청할 때 사용한다. 무수식 AI slop/deslop/refactor는 host ai-slop-cleaner가 소유한다.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 触发清理AI生成物的操作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常需要清理AI生成的大量低质量内容。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to clean up large amounts of low-quality AI-generated content.

howto.what: 你说出“tfx-prune”后，Claude 会调用三个 AI 分别审查代码，找出多余的“AI slop”。只有至少两个 AI 都认定的问题才会被清理，随后运行测试验证安全，并输出报告。
howto.when: 明确请求“tfx-prune”或“TFX 三方一致 cleanup”时触发；可附带文件路径或 git 范围。

say.text: 请用 tfx-prune 清理最近改动的代码。
say.note: 检查 git 最新变更的文件。

say.text: 对 src/utils 目录执行 tfx-prune。
say.note: 只审查该目录下的源码。
处理最近五次提交涉及的文件。

howto.what_en: When you say “tfx-prune”, Claude launches a three-way review: three AIs inspect the code separately for redundant “AI slop”. Issues confirmed by at least two AIs are removed, then tests run to verify safety, and a report is produced.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you explicitly ask for “tfx-prune” or a “TFX tri-verified cleanup”; you may also provide a file path or git diff range.

say_en.text: Please use tfx-prune to clean up recently changed code.
Run tfx-prune on the src/utils directory.
say_en.note: Only reviews source in that folder.
Handles files from the last five commits.
